title: Composition of inverse in-context functions with explicit FV arithmetic and product Views
hypothesis: On six known-composable inverse relation pairs in pinned Pythia-70m, a per-task shared-PCA product View (m_a elementwise-product m_b decoded through a common basis) will improve held-out identity-composition accuracy by >=0.10 absolute over both raw FV sum and difference in both dev worlds, while using <=0.50x explicit FV bank bytes. Native code-product is a mandatory attribution control.
physical_object: Frozen Pythia-70m-deduped at revision e93a9faa9c77e5d09219f6c868bfc7a1bd65593c plus sixteen support-extracted residual-stream function vectors.
mirror_coordinate: Each function ID has a code m_t in a centered shared PCA basis; composition of inverse relation functions (a,b) uses coordinate product m_a elementwise-product m_b and basis decoding.
logical_multiplicity: Six known-composable inverse function pairs across capitals, state abbreviations, element symbols, number words, and English/French and English/Spanish relations; 48 held-out queries per world.
controls: First operand FV and second operand FV separately
Centered native PCA code Hadamard product with the same basis/decoder as Mirror

task.function_vector_extraction: Reuse the frozen MA-516 implementation: average leave-one-support-pair-out demonstration activation minus query-only activation over eight support pairs for each relation task.
task.composition_target: Each listed pair is an inverse relation pair. Sequential function composition is identity on the first relation's eight held-out query keys; the candidate set is those eight keys.
task.inverse_pair_split: Shared underlying relation-entry IDs are assigned to support/evaluation together for both forward and inverse operand functions, preventing a held-out composed path from leaking through the inverse task supports.
task.primary_metric: top-1 identity-composition accuracy across 48 held-out queries
secondary_metrics: support extraction and inference wall time
task.construction: The six fixed inverse task pairs are IDs 0/1 capitals; 4/5 state/postal codes; 6/7 element/symbol; 8/9 number/digit; 12/13 English/French; 14/15 English/Spanish. For each inverse pair, use the same underlying eight relation entries as support/evaluation splits in both directions; thus a held-out composition path appears in neither operand FV support. For each query-only prompt to the first function, score the original query key against the eight held-out keys using the composed intervention.

development.selection: Report all operand controls and fixed ranks. Do not tune task pairs, basis rank, layer or intervention scale after accessing development scores.

fresh.opening_rule: Open only if product composition exceeds both raw sum and raw difference by >=.10 accuracy, preserves a useful positive composition result, fits <=.50x bytes, and has >=10% margin over native code-product.

paid_objects: explicit method: all sixteen operand FVs, pair IDs, operator and model/layer schema
product method: basis, mean, all sixteen codes, pair IDs, operator and model/layer schema
storage.common_base: Include pinned model/config/tokenizer actual bytes in total deployment; common across methods. No reconstructed vectors are persistently cached.

compute.extra_compute_proxy: There are 48 queries x 8 candidate sequences x 512 activation additions. Explicit arithmetic also pays one 512-vector sum/difference/product per requested composition. Code product pays r coordinate multiplies plus a 512xr decode once for each of six requested pair views, plus activation additions. Report the product-vector build time separately from query forward time.
compute.hardware: CPU, fixed five-thread limit, no GPU.

gates.PROMISING: In both seeds, code-product top-1 accuracy exceeds raw sum and raw difference by >=.10 absolute and explicit FV single-operand controls, while native-control comparison shows >=10% useful Mirror-specific margin and payload <=.50x explicit operand-bank bytes.
gates.FAIL: Frozen composition quality/storage gate misses or native code-product exactly matches Mirror without the required margin.
gates.NOT_ESTABLISHED: The fixed inverse pair does not produce an identity target, external model artifact fails integrity, or result replay fails.

boundaries: A small constrained-ranking screen on one 70M model; not broad language reasoning or open-ended generation.
The inverse function pairs are mathematically composable; whether activation-vector arithmetic realizes their composition is measured, not assumed.
A product code that equals native PCA code arithmetic is not Mirror-specific evidence.
Fresh seeds remain sealed unless all quality, byte and attribution gates pass.
